name: Skills
summary: Inline Foundry Skills packaged into a Toolbox and delivered to a BYOM-routed agent via MCP.
description: Verified live 2026-07-15 against westus3 with azure-ai-projects 2.3.0 (following the official sample_agent_toolbox_skill.py pattern): `project.beta.skills.create(...)` returns HTTP 202, the SDK's LRO poller then hits a service-side conflict ('Skill is in state \'Creating\' and cannot accept new versions'), and the skill is left permanently stuck — `list_versions` stays empty and the portal cannot open the skill either (repro: byomprobec1f434a1). Because no version resource ever materializes, no toolbox can reference it, so BYOM support cannot be validated end-to-end.
notes: Service-side bug (NOT an SDK client bug): default_version='1' is claimed on the parent Skill resource but get_version(name, '1') returns 404 and list_versions() returns []. Reproducible in the Microsoft Foundry portal (fails to load the same skill). Once the service ships a fix, the delivery path itself (Toolbox+MCP, verified in the toolboxes card) is BYOM-supported, so this should flip to supported/preview without a code change beyond removing the xfail. Reference sample: https://github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-python/blob/main/sdk/ai/azure-ai-projects/samples/agents/tools/sample_agent_toolbox_skill.py
